meta.description: PC creation gate. If created=false, the GM MUST run Session Zero before play proceeds.

pc.name: Agran Moorcroft
pc.high_concept: The Bloody Bard Quester of Solitude.
aspects: The Bloody Bard Quester of Solitude.
Bard's College Graduate & Honorable Imperial Soldier.
The Wolf of Solitude — Slayer of Galmar.
Hadvar's Shield-Brother in Song and Steel.
pc.stunt_1: Rallying Cry: Once per scene he may Create Advantage, and gain a +2 to his Rapport 4dF rolls to inspire Imperial Soldier's to push back against their adversaries, and create a Scene Aspect 'Rallied' (2 free invokes for himself or his fellow soldiers). On SWS his allies gain an additional +2 to their first Fight 4dF this Scene.
pc.stunt_2: Bard's College Alumni: When playing his War Drum, or Lute, he receives a +2 on Craft 4dF rolls, or a +2 to Rapport Rolls made when singing.
pc.stunt_3: College of Swords: When fighting against only one opponent, he receives +2 to Defense Rolls he makes with Fight. On SWS he may forgo the Boost to Create Advantage, and attempt to impose a Scene Aspect on his opposition 'Disarmed', 'Feinting blow', 'Fancy Foot Work'.
pc.stunt_4: Vampiric Mist Form: Once per scene, you may become mist to escape/reposition; use Athletics or Will to Overcome/Defend with +2, or Create Advantage 'Mist-Shrouded' (1 free invoke) on success.

vampire_milestones.note: Claimed on max blood potency + blood revelation.

extras: Brevet Praefect of the Imperial Legion

extras_details.name: Brevet Praefect of the Imperial Legion
extras_details.notes: Acting battlefield authority to issue orders and coordinate small units of Imperial Legionnaires / allied Whiterun guards when chain-of-command plausibly allows it.

extras_details.name: Mace of Molag Bal (Artifact Extra)
aspects: Mace of Molag Bal — Hunger in Iron
stunts: Shaken Will (repo canon): Once per session, when you win a social conflict by intimidation, you may also inflict a mild consequence 'Shaken Will' (fictional follow-through required).

Draining Blow: Once per scene, on a hit with Fight using the Mace, either place 'Sapped (Stamina/Magicka Drained)' with 1 free invoke (2 on SWS), OR clear one stress box and gain 'Taste of Power' (GM gets 1 free invoke).
Soul Snare: When you Take Out someone with the Mace, declare 'Soul Bound' for the scene and gain Boost 'Captured Essence' (+2 once on soul/undead/warding/daedra-related Lore/Will/Provoke).

relationships.name: Sybille Stentor
relationships.relationship: Confidant, only one who knows his vampirism

inventory: Mace of Molag Bal (wrapped; Imperial custody)

artifacts.name: Mace of Molag Bal
artifacts.note: Claimed in Markarth's Abandoned House. A domination-rite focus. Carries Bal's attention.

blood_echoes.clue: candlelit hall; signet ring (crescent over tower); voice: 'Good. Let them watch you win.'
Orders fragment: 'DELAY COURIER. TEST SEAL.' Phrase overheard: 'The Witness'. Crescent-over-tower symbol copied on dispatch slip.

blood_echoes.trigger: Major feed: Crescent Witness field leader
blood_echoes.clue: Ink-sting on the tongue; a whistle cord; the words 'SUBJECT CONFIRMED' and 'REPORT TO: MARKARTH DROP' signed only '—THE WITNESS'. A flash of a door that shouldn't be there, and a low voice: 'Bring him to stone.'
